mechanisms.architecture_disposition: A minimum that enforces material availability/capacity can be an exact physical boundary. Its validity does not justify unrelated minimum-score cognition or prove that mounted chemistry nourishes the organism.
mechanisms.lawful_remedy: Retain declared material units and exact conservation; derive requested transfer, capacities and target effects. Bind actual food/body sources, reachable local consumption/recovery and measured execution.
mechanisms.acceptance_falsifier: For every admitted transfer, source loss equals destination gain, amounts stay within bounds, and failure is atomic. A conserved isolated transfer without neuronal/body effect cannot pass nourishment.
